annotation.justification: The clause provides clear and specific requirements for TCP implementations when PUSH flags are not implemented. It mandates that the sending TCP must not buffer data indefinitely and must set the PSH bit in the last buffered segment. These requirements are unambiguous and do not allow for multiple materially different interpretations.
